title: Background jobs
routing: Is this about running work outside the request: defining, registering or enqueuing a background job? Signals: makeJob / makeSingletonJob / makeSupersedingJob, enqueueJob and buildJobData, staged jobs (ctx.enqueueChildJob / ctx.enqueueChildJobs, makeEnqueueChildJobs), handlers/index.ts registration, WorkerContext / ctx.log / ctx.signal, job ids (validateJobId / isValidJobId), the BullMQ queue, processJob and initializeWorker, rolling caches (coordinateRollingCaches), BullBoard, POST /api/admin/job, or a fire-and-forget promise or setTimeout standing in for a job. CronJob schedules are `cron`; fast/slow lanes and the JobOutbox overflow buffer are `job-lanes-outbox`.

recognise.note: recognise/pick split under test (model round); not the standard
